senses.gloss: m. (עָמַר) heaping up, carrying sheaves home.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Peah 4:6">Peah IV, 6</cite> <he>אין השכחה אלא בשעת הע׳</he> the law concerning the forgotten sheaf begins to be binding only at the time of carrying sheaves home; <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 282">Sifré Deut. 282</cite>.
Sabb. 73ᵇ אין ע׳ אלא בגידולי קרקע ʿimmur (as Sabbath labor) applies only to plants. Y. ib. VII, 10ᵃ bot. תולדות הע׳ the secondary labors coming under the category of ʿimmur; a. e.
